siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Ralf Berendsen
siblings.summary: Six day-trip shapes around the 2-star Ralf Berendsen at Domaine La Butte aux Bois — Maastricht, Hoge Kempen, Bokrijk+Genk, Tongeren, Hasselt, Valkenburg — with hours, 2026 ticket prices and drive times.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Ralf Berendsen
siblings.summary: Eleven character stays within a 20-minute taxi of the 2-star Ralf Berendsen, from the on-site Relais & Châteaux to a Gothic-monastery design hotel and a moated Lanaken kasteel.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Ralf Berendsen
siblings.summary: 2026 IT conferences within ~30 km of Ralf Berendsen (Paalsteenlaan 90, Lanaken). MECC Maastricht is 7 km away and anchors the year (ICT&health Jan, IEEE WCCI Jun, BNAIC Oct, BSBF Oct); Corda Campus Hasselt hosts BSides Limburg (Mar) and FTI Festival (Oct-Nov).

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Ralf Berendsen
sources.claim: Ralf Berendsen holds two Michelin stars at Paalsteenlaan 90, inside Domaine La Butte aux Bois.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — La Butte aux Bois (hotel)
sources.claim: Michelin-keyed hotel on a 1924 estate at the edge of Hoge Kempen, rooms across Le Manoir, La Villa, La Forêt.

sources.title: Small Luxury Hotels — La Butte aux Bois
sources.claim: Small Luxury Hotels of the World member, 5-star, on the edge of Hoge Kempen.

sources.title: Booking.com — La Butte aux Bois
sources.claim: 62 rooms with air conditioning, bathrobes, free WiFi and safes; on-site spa, indoor pool, fine-dining.

Tripadvisor — La Butte aux Bois
sources.claim: #1 of 3 hotels in Lanaken, 4.6/5 from 795 reviews.

sources.title: Relais & Châteaux — Belgium
sources.claim: La Butte aux Bois is a Relais & Châteaux member.

sources.title: Domaine La Butte aux Bois
sources.claim: Official hotel site lists Shiseido Spa Aquamarijn, Le Ciel bistro, Bar Papillon, Restaurant Ralf Berendsen.

sources.title: Expedia — Hotel Admiraal
sources.claim: 26 rooms, free breakfast buffet, sauna and hot tub.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Hotel Admiraal
sources.claim: 3.5/5 across 27 reviews; #3 of 3 in Lanaken; no air conditioning, traffic-side rooms noisy.

sources.title: near-place — Hotel Admiraal GPS
sources.claim: Hotel Admiraal GPS coordinates 50.9109774, 5.6812467 at Staatsbaan 81, 3620 Neerharen.

sources.title: OSRM — Admiraal → La Butte route
sources.claim: Walking route is 1,124 m via OSRM (~13–14 min at 5 km/h).

sources.title: Kayak — Hotel Admiraal rates
sources.claim: Nightly rates start around $90; older reviews mention ~€50 (room only).

sources.title: World's 50 Best Discovery — Ralf Berendsen
sources.claim: Ralf Berendsen recognised by World's 50 Best Discovery as a destination restaurant.

sources.title: Lanaken wiki — Paalsteenlaan
sources.claim: Paalsteenlaan is a side street of the N78; called Steenweg north, Staatsbaan south.

sources.title: Belvicci — La Butte transport
sources.claim: Nearest public-transport stop is Neerharen Dobbelsteynstraat, ~400 m from the hotel.

sources.title: Visit Limburg — La Butte aux Bois
sources.claim: Lanaken-area luxury venue with on-site fine dining and event hosting.

sources.title: Mimi's natuurhuisje
sources.claim: 2-person nature cottage at Heidestraat 101 E73; bedandbreakfast.eu 9.6/10; ~3.7 km on foot to La Butte.
